sections.title: Source and authority
sections.text: PRESERVED: Abjuration rank4 through each actual access row, base7 RP, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, and temporarily sending one creature to another plane. Core labels duration Instantaneous and provides no concrete save, exile destination, timer or return method. NEW proposals below supply those missing procedures; none is recovered cosmology, an existing class ability, or approved playtest text. The old wait-for-push sequencing hold is satisfied. Banish Unholy remains a different Cleric technique and grants neither this spell nor its destination/return rules.

sections.title: Casting and target
sections.text: Choose one actually perceived creature within60 feet and line of effect, including yourself. Use its current body, not an image, corpse or soul record. Actual creature-classified Undead and Constructs remain eligible unless an exact defense applies. Require actual class access/repertoire, V/S/F, Action, ordinary casting affordability, real target geometry and the ordinary cast/counter sequence. NEW concentration starts at legal cast commitment, displacing incompatible prior concentration; maximum exile is60 elapsed seconds from successful resolution. A saved-against, countered or otherwise failed cast keeps paid costs and does not restore prior concentration.

sections.title: Save, hard-control and replacement
sections.text: NEW target CHA save against the actual casting-class spell DC, binary; an actually willing target may elect failure before rolling. Success produces no exile. Apply real defenses, including an actually acquired Oracle Fate-Bound Boon IV +2 against banishment; Charmed-only immunity does not block an effect imposing no Charmed condition. Treat establishment as one hard encounter-removal component under the shared source-character/target/encounter guard: if that source already spent its guard, no exile occurs and no invented soft effect replaces it. A single continuing application does not spend again each turn. Only one live Banishment application may attach to a creature across casters; an already attached creature is ineligible for another until the first ends, with no replacement, stacked cell or renewed timer. Known illegality prevents commitment; hidden eligibility is adjudicated after commitment without a diagnostic/refund.

sections.title: Explicit proposed destination
sections.text: NEW bounded spell-space proposal requiring independent GPT cosmology/interface review: successful resolution creates one isolated temporary extraplanar cell distinct from the origin plane, then transports the same target into it. It is not identified with Bastion of Flame, Veiled Expanse, Radiant Currents, Boundless Void, any mortal Great Wheel label, an afterlife, a named god or an unresolved cosmic identity. It establishes no reusable route, recovered world or global plane-creation permission. The cell has a level supporting floor, ordinary light and a breathable environment compatible with the admitted creature; it itself inflicts no temperature/pressure/environmental damage. Existing disease, damage, life states and other hazards attached to the creature continue normally. Floor, walls, light and air are ephemeral spell boundaries, not harvestable stock. Cell dimensions are the target’s actual occupied bounding dimensions plus10feet along each axis, rounded up to5-foot increments, with its initial body centered legally; this supplies5feet of clearance on each side without a source-absent size/type cap. Geometry must be an actual established finite body record, not invented hidden anatomy.

sections.title: Agency and isolation
sections.text: The target retains its existing condition-limited Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, movement and concentration. The banishment itself imposes neither Incapacitated nor stasis. Boundaries prevent mundane passage and ordinary line of sight/effect into another place; there is no native exit or attack path. Independently acquired exact cross-plane information/travel powers retain their actual permissions and costs; the spell creates no knowledge of another destination, receiving headquarters or portal. An actual legal escape leaving the cell ends this Banishment immediately without dragging the escaped identity back. A failed escape spends only its own source-defined costs. No other creature can be admitted through a new Banishment or by calling it cargo; independently legal interplanar entry still needs its actual route, known destination and fitting space, and does not receive a free return entitlement.

sections.title: Clocks, concentration and source ending
sections.text: NEW this spell uses a fixed absolute deadline of resolution+60elapsed seconds. Traveler time and outside time advance1:1 for this cell only. Extra turns, initiative changes, suppression, travel, death, scene changes and companion control changes do not restart it; no rest/resource benefit is created. Ordinary personal effect durations, concentration checks, HP/Wounds, death saves, Stable recovery, summon expiry, Opening/Horn and Hunt histories continue on their existing clocks. Ending required concentration, actual dispel of this application, actual suppression of this application, or the absolute deadline initiates return and ends the isolation rather than suspending it for later resumption. A caster may end its own concentration through the normal permission. Mere distance or separation onto the cell’s plane does not end this spell. Independent condition/source rules still apply.

sections.title: Transport and real cargo
sections.text: Transport one creature identity with its actually worn/carried noncreature gear within real carrying and dimensional limits. No second creature travels as gear, including a mount, carried passenger, swallowed separate creature or controlled companion. Before departure establish legal origin placement for any separate carried body that will remain; if that separation is physically impossible, no transport occurs. Do not cut, copy or move an external anchor/fixture merely by calling it inventory: a tethered assembly that cannot be transported intact with this one body prevents that proposed transaction unless another actual rule already permits separation. Known physical impossibility is preflight failure; hidden or intervening impossibility defeats the paid transport without refund. This is an explicit NEW atomic-transport limit to be reviewed, not a claim that mundane restraints universally block other teleports. Record every actual transported object, its custody and its physical location. Objects used/consumed/ended inside follow their own rules; no replacement appears on return.

sections.title: Return anchor and early-return proposal
sections.text: NEW finite-return mechanism requiring explicit review: preserve the exact legal origin footprint/orientation and height as the return anchor; it does not move with the caster, an origin vehicle or a later map view. There is no force-wall reservation. Before an actual event would make that footprint illegal for the target’s then-current returning body, end this banishment and return it to the still-legal anchor first, then continue that event under ordinary rules. This includes another body/object entering the anchor, terrain/support changes, and a target body/gear transformation that would no longer fit the anchor or cell. The early return occurs at the event’s real resolution boundary, before the geometry changes, never rewinds a completed atomic damage/life event and never cancels committed costs. After return, the event can affect the target normally; ordinary movement may stop because a returned body now occupies its intended destination. This is a scoped NEW spell behavior, not a universal preemptive-trigger system or a source of remote information. A support-loss event returns the creature before loss and then ordinary Falling applies; a plane-destruction event does not grant immunity. No knowingly invalid origin anchor may be accepted at casting.

sections.title: Return transaction and exceptional collision
sections.text: At ordinary early ending/deadline, place the same current target body at its recorded still-legal anchor once, with the gear actually still carried. Do not create a new body, refresh HP or move a creature that already escaped independently. If true death occurred, return the same surviving corpse; Hunt/return-from-death law is unchanged because moving a corpse is not resurrection. If an independent source actually removed the body, return no substitute. Existing noncreature objects left in the cell return once to the anchor’s floor in their recorded stable object-ID order, using actual nearest legal placements for loose objects without embedding or duplicating them; items already taken out are absent from that list. A separately arrived creature has no automatic return grant and prevents final collapse while physically present; that unresolved exceptional occupancy requires the exact entry source’s exit/return procedure. This last interaction is explicitly unresolved for review, not permission to strand or delete a body. If a supplied effect makes the anchor illegal without the proposed pre-resolution return window, do not improvise crushing, eviction, duplication or an indefinite denied turn: record the actual collision and resolve an explicit joint-review completion before this draft can be adopted.

sections.title: Current spell and relic interfaces
sections.text: Counterspell acts only during legal cast windows. A minimum-rank4 Banishment does not qualify for the pending rank0–3 Spell Shield merely because its RP was discounted. Dimensional Anchor is currently in the separate AC4 review; its proposed endpoint prevention is comparison evidence until accepted, not an existing approved source. A real applicable transport block at either endpoint defeats travel under its own rule; it never produces partial cargo. Xi can end only this ongoing spell’s eligible creature target branch with actual caster/target consent, perception, range, Action and charge; there is no general remote release from merely possessing the pendant. Source owner, target, damage dealer and transport identity remain separate. Return itself causes no attack/damage/healing, and the spell grants no alignment change, oath exception, permanent exile, origin-plane diagnosis or immunity to Hunted Death.

reviewQuestions.question: Does the scoped generated extraplanar cell preserve the original temporary-other-plane effect without adopting forbidden cosmological identities? Accept/revise its exact local topology; do not assert it is recovered canon.
Confirm the proposed concentration60s/CHA save, willing-failure permission, one-live-application rule and shared hard-control use against actual class/source scope.

Resolve the return mechanism completely. Is early return before origin/body geometry change coherent with actual atomic event boundaries and transport prevention? Replace exact operations where needed; no indefinite hard-denial extension, crushing or silently suppressed costs.

Complete independently legal interplanar entry and escape, residual cargo and cell collapse. The draft flags exceptional visitors and uninterruptible anchor changes rather than silently stranding/deleting them; a full runnable resolution is required before approval.

Confirm one-body transport, carried creatures, swallowed separate bodies, mounts, tethers, custody, transformations, true death/body removal and Null-disabled summons without rewriting other teleport or lifecycle rules.

Use current accepted AC4 outcomes when available for Anchor/Shield/Beacon integration, and preserve actual Oracle/Cleric/Xi distinctions. No generic resistance, saved-score migration, lore revelation or control immunity may be inferred.

operational.targets: One unoccupied space you perceive within range and line of effect large enough to contain the mount.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier at concentration end or steed0 HP.
operational.resolution: No creation roll. A commanded Planar Crossing uses the steed's Action and its one crossing attempt. Spend that use when the attempt starts. It teleports the steed, any eligible mounted rider and permitted gear together to a specific known site on another plane, or fails safely at origin if arrival is illegal or an exact ward blocks it. Failure does not refund the attempt or actions and reveals no reason or hidden coordinates.
operational.effect:
Create a Large noncombat spectral mount: AC 14, HP 30, walking Speed60, body mass 500 pounds, saves equal to owner PB, other checks+0, ordinary sight/hearing; it understands the owner's spoken commands without speech or telepathy. It acts immediately after the owner. An owner Bonus Action command within 60 feet and perceptible to it permits movement plus Dodge, Dash or Planar Crossing; Dash uses the ordinary movement-budget rules. It shares the owner-wide companion command allowance but supplies no damaging Action. Uncommanded it may move defensively and Dodge. It may carry one willing Medium-or-smaller rider plus that rider's legally carried noncreature gear, within 350 pounds AND 12 Load total. Count the rider's effective body weight plus every item once; count body casualty Load (Tiny 1.5/Small 3/Medium 6) plus all gear Load, including melded gear. At 6–12 Load it is Burdened under BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md: Speed reduced10 feet and relevant check disadvantage. These fixed capacities do not imply a Strength score. Mounting requires an Action while adjacent to the stationary steed and within both capacities. Dismounting voluntarily requires an Action while it is stationary, to a legal adjacent space; this Action includes that placement. While riding, select one 5-foot portion of the steed's footprint as the rider's position; it moves with that portion, without free repositioning among its squares. Other positioning requires actual legal movement/actions. If the steed disappears or the rider can no longer legally ride, the rider remains at their current rider position and ordinary support/Falling applies; use the body guide's minimum adjacent placement rule if a persistent steed/obstruction makes that position illegal, never teleport through a barrier. An imposed excess load or anatomy change cannot be vetoed to preserve riding.

For Planar Crossing, the owner chooses one specific arrival site on a different plane that they personally visited or can uniquely identify from a reliable map, description or established source. The command authorizes the attempt; the steed spends its Action after the owner. A mounted rider must still willingly accept and fit the capacity/anatomy rules. An unladen steed may also cross. Arrival needs legal space for the whole mount and rider; ordinary support requirements apply, so unsupported arrival leads to Falling rather than hover. Distance to the destination is not limited by the 60-foot summoning/command range. The spell provides the interplanar transition itself without requiring an existing portal, but no same-plane teleport. The group moves atomically, preserving relative rider position, belongings, conditions and ongoing clocks. Nothing is left in a between-planes buffer. No portal remains for followers.
operational.scaling: Only its expressly printed owner-PB saves change. Fixed AC 14/HP 30/Speed60 before ordinary burden/conditions,350 lb/12 Load capacity and one crossing do not automatically scale.
operational.limitations: One Spectral Steed per caster; one crossing attempt per steed. Resummoning requires a new legal paid cast and new mounting/commands, never a free refresh. This profile grants no attack, autonomous opportunity attack, Help advantage, flight, hover, phase movement, special senses, resistance/immunity, spellcasting, sale value, loot, corpse or resource trigger. No additional carrying capacity, gear ownership change or magical location search is supplied. Its known destination need not be visible or in originating line of effect; the explicit interplanar exception is still subject to actual arrival legality and written blockers. The command must be valid at attempt start; crossing itself does not cancel that already committed command because distance/plane then changes. Future commands require their own actual range/perception. Concentration is not given an extra plane/range tether; clocks continue. Dismissal does not return or delete riders/property. Travel may avoid a geographic route segment but does not settle claims, contamination, law, Opening time or Extraction by declaration. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. completeRecord.name: Counterspell

operational.activation: Reaction — when another creature you can perceive within range and line of effect begins casting a spell, after its casting costs and cadence are committed but before its effect resolves
operational.targets: One pending spell cast by the triggering creature. The spell needs an actual recorded rank; the Director may know that rank without revealing it to you.
operational.resolution: make a spellcasting-ability check using the actual ability for the class through which you cast Counterspell, adding PB once, against DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank (rank 0 contributes 0). Use CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md's fixed-DC task degrees and natural shifts: at least DC+10 Critical Success, at least DC Success, at most DC-10 Critical Failure, otherwise Failure; natural 20 improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one. Collapse both upper degrees to success and both lower degrees to failure; invent no additional critical effect. This is not a spell attack or saving throw.
operational.effect: Success negates the selected pending spell after its costs were committed; failure lets it continue. Every interruptible cast first commits its RP/material/other costs, components, concentration transition, Dissonance/Refrain and exact beginning/casting hooks once, then opens the interruption window. A surviving cast later resolves its effect and outcome-dependent hooks. Negation gives no refund, no successful-effect trigger and no restoration of old concentration. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out; if a counter is negated, the earlier pending spell resumes without paying or casting again. Resuming a parent never rewrites the later nested cast's Refrain/Dissonance history.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic success against lower ranks and no generic upcast.
operational.limitations: One attempt per creature against a particular pending cast, shared across ordinary, Wizard, Mage and other same-named Counterspell sources. An exact source that expressly grants an additional Counterspell attempt against the same pending cast overrides this default; merely granting another Reaction does not. After a failed attempt another eligible creature may react; once negated, the spell supplies no further interruption trigger. All reactions need their own legal remaining resource, components, range and current source permissions. Attempting does not reveal spell identity/rank; never treat an unassigned rank as 0 or estimate it from RP. Ready opens its cast-interruption window at preparation, not release. Countering is not whole-Action/turn hard denial and does not spend that ledger. Ordinary Counterspell requires ordinary repertoire/class access and rank-3 cost; Wizard/Mage same-named class cards keep their own separate acquisition, printed costs, ranks, recharge and text. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

NEW: actual casting ability+PB against DC 10+2*rank, one attempt per pending cast, hidden-rank handling and nested timing. REVIEWED SOURCE CORRECTION: the earlier binary-check proposal is superseded by the existing Core fixed-DC task rule, with natural shifts and collapsed success/failure outcomes.
